DayZ Tools

In-Browser Tools

These tools run in your browser and do not require any downloads or installations.

  • P3D Converter

    Convert DayZ ODOL or MLOD .p3d files to MLOD + model.cfg or FBX.

    •

  • PAA to PNG

    Convert DayZ .paa files to PNG.

    •

  • PBR to DayZ Texture Converter

    Convert PBR textures into DayZ format.

    •

  • Map Images

    A collection of map terrain images, periodically updated.

    •

Offline Tools

These tools are downloadable and run on your computer.

  • pbr2dayz

    Convert PBR textures to DayZ textures and back again.

    •

  • odol

    Convert DayZ ODOL files to MLOD + model.cfg or FBX.

    •

  • DayZ Event Summary

    Generate an HTML summary of DayZ events from server logs.

    •

  • DayZ ArmorPaint Export Preset

    Export DayZ textures directly from ArmorPaint.

    •

  • DayZ Terrain Map

    Generate a map of DayZ from terrain textures.

    •

Developer Libraries

Many of these are incomplete. The more complete and usable ones are listed first.

  • go-pbo

    Go module for reading and writing PBO files.

    •

  • go-paa

    Go module for reading and writing PAA files.

    •

  • go-bisign

    Go module for reading, creating, signing and verifying BI keys.

    •

  • go-p3d

    Go module for reading and writing P3D files.

    •

  • go-bicpp

    Go module for parsing and generating BI CPP files.

    •

  • go-adminlog

    Go module for parsing DayZ server ADM logs.

    •

  • go-raP

    Go module for reading and writing binarized files.

    •
